info.name: FVST Express Driver API
info.description:
Driver app endpoints served by fvstexpress-admin under /driver-api/v1.

1. Pick an environment (Local WAMP or Android emulator) and set driverLogin / driverPin to a driver whose PIN was set in Drivers › Edit driver.
2. Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner or newman): they follow a real driver day — log in, load tasks, pick up, deliver with a photo, fail the second drop-off, messages, end of day, log out.

Tokens and stop keys are filled in automatically. Every call is visible in the admin under Drivers › Driver API Log.
Writes send an Idempotency-Key header so retried offline taps are applied once.
